s4_label.heading: 5.1 Diabetic Ketoacidosis in Patients with Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus and Other Ketoacidosis

supporting_quote_or_value: Signs and symptoms are consistent with dehydration and severe metabolic acidosis and include nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, generalized malaise, and shortness of breath.
rationale: Here abdominal pain is listed as a presenting sign of ketoacidosis, not as a separate reaction to Farxiga.
uncertainty: Debatable: ketoacidosis itself is the drug-related warning, so a reviewer may treat its symptoms as reactions. Pancreatic disorders in the same passage are risk factors. Scoped to SPL 72ad22ae-efe6-4cd6-a302-98aaee423d69 v49 (effectiveTime 20260603) and this passage only.
